_noteQ: Cull the Meek (RenektonCleaveAbility): BasicDamage = BaseDamage + 1.0*bonusAD (mStat 2, mStatFormula 2). Single AoE cleave hit per enemy struck. EmpDamage = the Fury-empowered variant (+140% bonusAD). M25 §11.G (loop 106): Fury is the caster's OWN resource, exposed live (GameSnapshot.ResourceValue), so this is now a ResourceGte-50 CONDITIONAL hit (AutoResolvable): calc:BasicDamage is the UNMET baseline (<50 Fury = the prior conservative reading, value identity), metCalc:EmpDamage is the MET value (>=50 Fury = empowered). Deterministic from live Fury, so it resolves the same in both range graphs (no widening) rather than a user knob. Supersedes the old 'Fury not tracked -> un-empowered only' note.
_noteW: Ruthless Predator (RenektonPredatorAbility applies the stun; the actual damage lives on the separate RenektonPreExecuteAbility spell object, calc HitDamage = BaseDamagePerHit + 0.75*bonusAD). Un-empowered Predator makes the next basic attack strike TWICE (wiki: base total 10/40/70/100/130 (+150% AD) = exactly 2x HitDamage) -- curated as HitDamage with count 2, not the pre-summed BasicTotalDamage/EmpTotalDamage modifiers, to match this schema's 'N instances hit one target' convention. Empowered 3-strike variant (EmpTotalDamage, Fury-gated) omitted -- conservative base reading.
_noteE: Slice and Dice (RenektonSliceAndDiceAbility): BasicDamage = BaseDamage + 0.9*bonusAD. One hit on the initial dash. The optional Dice recast (a second, separately-triggered dash the player must press again) repeats the same formula as an independent cast, not a passive multi-hit of the first E -- left as count 1 for the single dash, consistent with how this project treats other same-key recasts as separate uses (e.g. Ahri R dashes) rather than inflating one node's count. M25 §11.G (loop 107): like Q, E has a Fury-empowered variant EmpDamage (EnragedBaseDamage 25->295 + EnragedADRatio, same spell object) -- so E is now a ResourceGte-50 CONDITIONAL hit (AutoResolvable, Fury is the caster's own live resource): calc:BasicDamage is the UNMET baseline (<50 Fury = the prior value, identity), metCalc:EmpDamage is the MET empowered value (>=50 Fury). Deterministic from live Fury -> resolves the same in both range graphs (no widening), same proven shape as Q. (W's empowered form is a 3rd STRIKE, i.e. a count change the single-hit conditional can't model, so W stays the conservative base 2-strike reading as documented.)
_noteR: Dominus (RenektonReignOfTheTyrantAbility): only calc is TotalDamagePerSecond, a mixed AD+AP self-buff AURA DoT ticking every 0.5s for 15s (30 ticks total, DataValue TickRate/BuffDuration) while transformed -- not a single burst hit. Matches this project's existing precedent of omitting ongoing pet/aura DoTs from the burst-combo model (see Annie R Tibbers aura, combo_damage_model_report.md). Genuinely not representable as a single hits[] entry without fabricating a burst number -- omitted (P2, honest).

R CURATED (loop 472, user request - it had tags but no damage at all, so a Dominus node contributed nothing). BIN RenektonReignOfTheTyrant.TotalDamagePerSecond = AuraDamagePerSecond + 0.1 x bonus AD + 0.1 x AP, with AuraDamagePerSecond[1..3] = 60/150/240. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Renekton, fetched 2026-08-20) states the aura ticks every 0.5s for 30/75/120 (+5% bonus AD)(+5% AP) per tick over a 15-second duration - two ticks a second is exactly 60/150/240 (+10%)(+10%), so the BIN's per-second naming is literal and the two sources agree to the digit. Curated through the flat per-second DoT mechanism (perSecondCalc, the Heimerdinger Q precedent) rather than as a full-duration lump: Dominus is a persistent aura the target walks out of, so the honest number depends on exposure. maxDurationSeconds is the ability's real 15s, and the node's 적중시간 knob decides how much of it landed - UNSET means 0 damage, the same conservative default every other duration-scaled hit uses, rather than assuming a target stood in it for fifteen seconds. Tagged Zone for the same reason.
